question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct option is "though".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look into **meaning **of the given options - 

 
 
• **though **- however.
 
• **in spite of** - used to show that something happened although you did not expect it.
 
• **as **- while something else is happening.
 
• **despite** - without being affected by the thing mentioned.
 
 
 
• The sentence with the blank points out how this type of behavior is shown in almost all countries but it is mostly seen in countries like Brazil, India, the US and even the UK.
